entities.name: WorkOS
entities.how_described: 本集嘉宾 Ryan 所在的公司，运行「产品工程文化」（团队里没有产品经理），并自建了 TARS/Horizon 两套系统来构建与众不同的软件工厂。

evidence.quote: We have taken a slightly different approach at WorkOS.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So we run this product engineering culture at WorkOS.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And we want this to be an evergreen context about what every person in the company is working on, what team do they sit in, what products are they responsible for, and then at an organization level, what is the semantics about WorkOS and how we do our work.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: I'm one of the engineers here at WorkOS.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 软件工厂 (software factories)
entities.how_described: 本集主题：把沙箱、编码智能体和提示词串成自动产出代码、开 PR、合并的流水线；WorkOS 的梦想定义是给每位工程师一个属于自己的小型工程团队，并强调要用成果指标而非产出指标衡量它。

evidence.quote: I know it's been a long week, but I'm excited to talk about a topic here that is very near and dear to me, software factories.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: I'm guessing if you're all here, you're very familiar with software factories.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: TARS
entities.how_described: 本集说它是 WorkOS 用户与编码智能体交互的界面，嵌入 Slack、Linear 和 GitHub，通过 webhook 跟踪项目进度、自动接手工单、分诊 bug 与支持请求。

evidence.quote: One is we have this system we call TARS.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We subscribe to webhooks through TARS so that TARS can actually track the progress of projects in addition to generating the code outputs.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Because TARS is getting webhooks on ticket completion, it can automatically pick up the next ticket in a cycle.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And so we can, through our planning process, construct a map of how we think this plan is going to get executed, and TARS can start to execute on that autonomously.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: The other thing that we have is in between those steps, when a ticket is completed, we can ask TARS, can you reevaluate the linear project and let me know if it's missing now tickets?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: TARS then goes in and creates all these resources for me.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: TARS is creating a first pass at that.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And so this then gives me an easy framework for me to step into as the lead product engineer and start giving more specification, rounding out areas that aren't well defined with knowledge that I know about what we're trying to accomplish with the project, and then hand it back to TARS for execution.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: When that's done, we'll mark this ticket as complete, and TARS will pick that up and move on to the next stage of project implementation.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So TARS through webhooks can listen to those and take a first pass at triaging and implementing, opening PRs to fix bugs.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We found TARS to be pretty useful to triage support requests that we're getting through them.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So we're using TARS to actually build out our own sandbox infrastructure.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We want to see our engineers using TARS as a sign that this is giving them value in accelerating their work.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: Horizon
entities.how_described: 本集说它是 WorkOS 的基础设施编排层，类似 Ramp 的 Inspect 和 Minions，但坐在 MCP 网关之前。

evidence.quote: And then we built a separate system called Horizon.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: MCP 网关 (MCP gateway)
entities.how_described: 本集称之为「上下文引擎」：连接所有内部系统并构建系统提示词，告诉智能体如何、何时使用工具；意外成为全公司从 Slack 直接查数据、做客户分析的杠杆。

evidence.quote: But it sits in front of an MCP gateway.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And I'm going to talk a little bit more about why that MCP gateway has been really transformational for us.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So I alluded to early on in the development of our factory is created our own MCP gateway.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And we're building a lot of other tools on top of this MCP gateway.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So if you're just getting started with thinking about a software factory, it is well worth your time to invest in an internal MCP gateway server that both connects all your tools
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 智能体 (agent)
entities.how_described: 本集的主线之一：编码智能体放在沙箱里生成 PR，还有专门的「PM 智能体」起草 Hilltop 文档、拆分工单；智能体还会被指向会话记录来自我改进工厂。

evidence.quote: You put an AI agent in there, maybe a Claude Code section or an open code.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: This is a way for users to interact with the coding agent.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And we want to continuously keep our plan fresh by using the agent itself.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: The agent is determining that there may be missing pieces to what we initially planned for the project and the goal that we have in mind.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Now we can give this resource to an agent, and an agent can break this into units of work.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So we don't need a human to be shepherding this agent through every single step of the life cycle.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So we created an agent specifically for this part of the process.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So what we found is like a lot of teams are now doing more project brief and hilltop work because our agent can seed all that information.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: The other thing that this lets us do is we don't necessarily always need to use our coding agent to implement pieces of work.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And then we can provide an agent through our MCP server in the tool description a list of here are the tables.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And so it gives us a little bit of orientation to an agent to understand how we use our tools, how we've organized Linear and Snowflake, and give some guidance on where to find information.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Envision that this would just be a way to connect our agent or coding agent to all of our systems.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: It has descriptions that can tell the agent how to use those tools and how you've specifically organized the information in them.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Where is there a skill that we should be building because the agent made a mistake?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: It's cool to run an agent and have it open a PR.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 沙箱 (sandbox)
entities.how_described: 本集说它是软件工厂标准配置里放代码和智能体的环境（WorkOS 第一版基于 Cloudflare 搭建），他们正用 TARS 自建沙箱基础设施以取代沙箱即服务。

evidence.quote: You have a sandbox that you put your code into.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: It started with the sandbox we built on top of Cloudflare.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So we're using TARS to actually build out our own sandbox infrastructure.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We want to see that they're electing to move out of their local harness and into a cloud sandbox.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 成果指标 (outcome metrics)
entities.how_described: 本集核心论点：PR 占比等产出指标可能掩盖系统真实效果，WorkOS 改为衡量交付是否加速、构建更多发布更多、缺陷率与恢复时间等成果。

evidence.quote: And so we measure instead of just code output, we're looking at outcome metrics.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: Hilltop 文档 (Hilltop)
entities.how_described: 本集说它是 WorkOS 产品工程文化的核心仪式：一份 PRD，定义项目目的、纳入客户需求、竞品分析、早期设计稿和里程碑，现在直接交给智能体拆分成工单。

evidence.quote: And one of the rituals as part of this product engineering process is we create a Hilltop document.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: But it can see that the Hilltop document, through linear tickets, has been reviewed and approved, and by virtue of it being approved, can start work on this project automatically.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And it is doing the first draft of the Hilltop based on the brief specification that we give it.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So we haven't done the Hilltop review yet here.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So what we found is like a lot of teams are now doing more project brief and hilltop work because our agent can seed all that information.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: Ramp
entities.how_described: 本集提到 Ramp 几个月前发博客介绍他们的 Inspect 系统，点燃了整个行业对软件工厂的兴趣。

evidence.quote: Ramp blogged about their inspects several months ago.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Same with the local Claude code, if you're just using Opus in a local harness.

entities.name: Linear
entities.how_described: 本集说它是 WorkOS 的项目管理工具，TARS 嵌入其中，利用有依赖关系的工单自动接力，并定期重评项目是否缺工单。

evidence.quote: So not just Slack, but also Linear and GitHub.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: In linear, we can define tickets that have dependencies.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: The other thing that we have is in between those steps, when a ticket is completed, we can ask TARS, can you reevaluate the linear project and let me know if it's missing now tickets?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: But it can see that the Hilltop document, through linear tickets, has been reviewed and approved, and by virtue of it being approved, can start work on this project automatically.

entities.name: 记忆层 (memory layer)
entities.how_described: 本集说这是 WorkOS 下一步要构建的东西：一个常青上下文，记录公司每个人在做什么、组织语义和工作方式，可插进软件工厂也可接入其他 AI 工具。
